h1: Attic Insulation Replacement in San Leandro, CA
description: Attic insulation replacement in San Leandro, CA: full removal and reinsulation of old, damaged attic insulation. Get a free inspection and written estimate.
intro: Full attic insulation replacement for East Bay homes: we vacuum out the old, compressed or contaminated material, seal the leaks, sanitize the space and reinsulate to the R-value your house needs. One fixed estimate covers the whole package.
hero_alt: Vacuuming out old attic insulation before replacement

paragraphs: Old attic insulation does not always need to come out. When it is compressed, damp, moldy or full of rodent damage, adding fresh material on top only buries the problem.
Replacement is the right call when the existing material has stopped doing its job or is contaminating the space. The inspection tells you which situation you have, with photos.
bullets: Compressed batts with little loft left
Water damage or mold from roof leaks
Rodent droppings, tunnels or nesting material
Old material settled far below target depth

sections.h2: What the full replacement package includes
paragraphs: Replacement is a complete job, not a topping-up exercise: everything comes out, the attic gets sealed and cleaned, and fresh material goes in to the R-value your house needs.
bullets: Full vacuum removal of the existing insulation
Air sealing of top plates, penetrations and bypasses
Sanitizing and cleanup of droppings and debris
New blown-in fiberglass or cellulose to target R-value

sections.h2: Rodent and moisture damage, handled in order
paragraphs: When the old insulation came out of a rodent attic, we seal the entry points before anything new goes in. Otherwise the replacement material becomes fresh nesting within a season.
The sequence is fixed: seal first, remove the contaminated material, sanitize the space, then reinsulate. Skipping any step wastes the one before it.
We plan the replacement around what is up there now: how much material has to be vacuumed out, whether it needs special disposal, and what the roof deck and vents look like underneath.
The estimate covers removal, sealing, material and install as one fixed number, so there are no surprises when the old insulation turns out worse than expected.
bullets: Removal volume and disposal included in the quote
Roof deck and vent check once the attic is bare
One fixed estimate for the whole package

sections.h2: What to expect on replacement day
paragraphs: A crew with a vacuum truck handles the removal, drop cloths protect the house, and most attics finish in a single day. We show you the bare deck before new material goes in, and the finished attic with depth markers before we leave.

faqs.q: Do I have to remove the old insulation?
faqs.a: Only if it is compressed, damp, moldy or rodent-damaged. Healthy material can often be topped up instead, and the inspection tells you which path applies to your attic.

faqs.q: How long does an attic insulation replacement take?
faqs.a: Most attics are done in one day, including removal. Rodent cleanup or very large attics can run into a second day, and the estimate says so.

faqs.q: What happens to the old material?
faqs.a: It is vacuumed out and disposed of properly, including material contaminated by droppings or mold. Removal and disposal are part of the fixed estimate.

faqs.q: Can you replace insulation if rodents have been up there?
faqs.a: Yes, and it is usually necessary. We seal the entry points, remove the contaminated material, sanitize, then reinsulate, in that order.

faqs.q: What R-value will the replacement reach?
faqs.a: Most East Bay attics land between R-38 and R-60. We quote the specific target for your attic after the inspection, and depth markers let you verify it.
Where San Leandro's Building and Safety Division requires one, we pull the permit and schedule the inspection, same as our other attic work.
